rules.intent: Color must come from theme tokens — no raw hex/rgb/hsl literals in UI files.
rules.rationale: Single source of truth for theme; enables dark mode and audience-specific theming.

rules.intent: Interactive controls must meet the minimum touch-target size — no undersized buttons, links, or form controls.
rules.rationale: WCAG 2.2 AA target-size baseline; undersized targets are the most common mobile a11y failure.

rules.intent: A screen shows at most one primary call-to-action — no competing accent-styled buttons.
rules.rationale: Multiple primary CTAs dilute the intended action and read as unstyled/uncurated.

rules.intent: Text must meet WCAG 2.x AA contrast against its effective background — no low-contrast copy.
rules.rationale: WCAG 2.2 AA text-contrast baseline (1.4.3) — the a11y anchor a taste ruling can't override.

rules.intent: Font size must come from the type-scale roles — no off-scale text utilities or size literals (e.g. text-sm, text-[0.8125rem]) in UI files.
rules.rationale: The typographic mirror of no-raw-color: one shared role set consumed by name keeps the scale the single source and the vertical rhythm uniform.

rules.intent: User-facing strings must be i18n keys, not string literals.
rules.rationale: Locale audience requires every user-facing string to be translatable.

rules.intent: Features may not import another feature's internals — only its public barrel.
Responsive behavior must use the named breakpoint/container roles — no raw media-query widths or arbitrary breakpoint values in UI files.
rules.rationale: The layout-system mirror of no-raw-color: one breakpoint scale consumed by name keeps responsive behavior uniform across surfaces.

rules.intent: Overlay shells (backdrop + focus-trap + dismiss — Sheet/Dialog/Popover/Drawer) live in the base dir and are imported from its barrel; none are hand-rolled outside it.
rules.rationale: Base primitives are system foundation, created once and imported everywhere; re-implementing an overlay shell in a feature file forks the focus-trap/dismiss/portal contract and drifts the design.
